situation: A Resident's booking gets a payment plan
given: a Resident booking with a departure date, at a Property whose billing is available, and a Staff Member holding front_desk.book with reach
when: they make a plan of three instalments
then: the plan and its instalments are stored in the Property's currency, name who made it, and are numbered in due-date order
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-01: a Front desk member makes the plan of a Resident booking

situation: One plan per booking
given: a booking that has a plan
when: a second plan is made for it
then: refused by the unique key on the booking; a change of plan is a revision of the one
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-02: a booking has one plan

situation: A Guest's booking takes no plan
given: a booking of a Guest
when: a plan is made for it
then: refused with RZP01: only a Resident pays by instalments
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-03: a Guest booking takes no plan

situation: A plan needs a term
given: a Resident booking with no departure date, or a booking with a plan
when: a plan is made for the open-ended one, or the planned one is made open-ended
then: refused with RZP02 both ways; the rule is on the plan and not on the operating model, so a hotel's long-stay Resident has it too
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-04: a plan needs the booking to have a departure date

situation: An instalment falls due within the term
given: a booking for a term
when: an instalment is due after its departure date
then: refused with RZP03; one due before the term starts is accepted, because the first payment is often taken at registration
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-05: an instalment cannot fall due after the term ends

situation: A booking that has ended takes no plan
given: a booking that is cancelled, no-show or checked out
when: a plan is made or revised
then: refused with RZP05
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-06: a booking that has ended takes no plan

situation: Between one and sixty instalments, each a positive amount
given: a plan being made
when: it has none, sixty-one, or an amount of zero
then: refused: the count by the function with 22023, the amount by the table's check
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-07: a plan has between one and sixty instalments of a positive amount (none)

situation: Who may make a plan
given: a Housekeeping member, a Staff Member of another Organization, and a Property that keeps no Folios
when: each tries to make a plan
then: the first two are refused with 42501 and the Property that bills nothing with RZP06, so a plan is never made that nothing could charge
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-08: a Housekeeping member makes no plan

situation: Nobody writes a plan directly
given: ranza_app
when: it inserts, updates or deletes a plan or an instalment
then: refused by grants: select is all it holds, except the two columns a booking's ending withdraws
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-09: the application role inserts no plan

situation: Plans are read by reach
given: a plan at one Property and a member of another Organization
then: they see none; a member with reach sees them
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-10: a member of another Organization reads no plan and no instalment

situation: Revising a plan
given: a plan with three instalments charged and two not
when: a Staff Member holding finance.post_charge revises it to three new instalments
then: the two uncharged are withdrawn as revised, the three charged stay, three are written as revision 2, nothing is deleted, and the plan names who revised and when
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-11: Finance revises a plan: the two instalments not charged are withdrawn, three are written, and the three charged stay

situation: Only finance revises
given: a Front desk member and a Finance member
when: each tries to revise a plan
then: the Front desk member is refused with 42501; they made the plan and hold no finance permission
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-12: the front desk makes a plan and does not revise it

situation: A charged instalment is history
given: an instalment whose Folio line exists
when: somebody withdraws it, changes its amount or date, or deletes it or its plan
then: refused with RZP04 for every writer, so a line is never left naming an instalment that was rewritten
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-13: a charged instalment cannot be withdrawn, by any writer

situation: The worker charges an instalment on its due date
given: a plan with an instalment due today, and a Resident in house with an open Folio
then: a charge is posted to the Folio, dated the due date, source instalment, described as the instalment's number of the total, and the pass reports it posted
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-14: the worker is told which Property has something to charge, by id

situation: An instalment is charged once
given: an instalment already charged
when: the pass runs again, or two passes run together
then: nothing is posted; the unique index on instalment_id is what stops the second, not a check
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-15: a second pass charges nothing

situation: An instalment not yet due is not charged
given: an instalment due tomorrow by the Property's own calendar, and two Properties a day apart
then: nothing is posted for it; it is upcoming; each Property is asked about its own date, so no single date can be right for both
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-16: an instalment that falls due tomorrow, or later, is not charged

situation: A Resident who has not arrived waits
given: an instalment fallen due and a Resident with no Folio yet
when: the pass runs, and again after they check in
then: the first pass posts nothing and counts it waiting; it is overdue by its date; the pass after check-in charges it dated its due date
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-17: an instalment fallen due before the Resident has a Folio is not charged

situation: A closed Folio or another currency waits
given: a fallen-due instalment whose Folio is closed, and another whose Folio trades in another currency
then: neither is charged and both are counted waiting, so one Resident never fails the Property's pass
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-18: a closed Folio, and a Folio in another currency than the plan's, are not charged; both wait and neither fails the pass

situation: A Property whose billing is unavailable is not charged
given: a Property whose finance capability is off or whose Subscription has lapsed
then: nothing is posted and the Property is not discovered
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-19: and not the Properties that have nothing, or keep no Folios

situation: The worker alone charges
given: ranza_app and ranza_worker
when: each calls the discovery and the posting function
then: only the worker may execute them, the shared definition of ready is granted to nobody, and the worker holds no grant on a plan table
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-20: the worker and the credentials role hold nothing on either table

situation: A worker context is the Organization's
given: no worker context, and a context for another Organization
when: the posting function is called for a Property
then: refused with 42501; a Property of another Organization and one that does not exist get the same answer as each other
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-21: charging needs a worker context

situation: A charge is announced
given: an instalment the pass charged
then: instalment.posted is published with ids and the amount, and no name; folio.line_posted is published by the Folio line as for any charge
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-22: charging an instalment publishes instalment.posted

situation: A withdrawn instalment is not charged
given: an instalment withdrawn by a revision
when: a Folio line naming it is inserted by any writer
then: refused with RZP04, and the worker re-reads the instalment under a lock before it posts
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-23: what is ready is the live instalment fallen due and not the withdrawn one

situation: A booking that ends withdraws what was not charged
given: a plan with one charged instalment and two not, and a booking cancelled, no-show or checked out
then: the two uncharged are withdrawn as reservation_ended and the charged one stays; the Staff Member that ended it does the withdrawing, bounded by a policy that asks reach, the front desk and the permission of the command that ended the booking (front_desk.cancel or front_desk.check_out), and by a grant of two columns
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-24: the desk cancels a booking that has a plan

situation: Overdue is defined once
given: an instalment past its due date, one due today and one due later, none paid
then: the first is overdue from the day after its due date in the Property's own calendar, the second due, the third upcoming; every reader of overdue reads this function
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-25: and the standing is read by the Property's own date too

situation: A payment settles the oldest instalment first
given: two instalments and a payment of one and a half instalments on the Folio
then: the first is paid and the second is partly paid, with what is left outstanding
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-26: a payment settles the oldest instalment first, and what is left of the second is outstanding

situation: A reversed payment re-opens an instalment
given: a paid instalment and the reversal of the payment
then: it is overdue again for the amount reversed
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-27: a reversed payment re-opens the instalments it had paid

situation: A reversed charge is waived
given: a charged instalment whose Folio line was reversed
then: it is waived, owes nothing, and covers none of the payments, which fall to the next instalment
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-28: a waived instalment owes nothing and covers none of the payment, which falls to the next

situation: Overdue at a Property
given: three Residents, two with an overdue instalment and one of them with two
then: it counts two students, three instalments and the money overdue, in the Property's currency, and is zero with no currency lost when nobody is overdue
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-29: two students are overdue, on three instalments, for 2,500.00, in the Property's currency

situation: Overdue is by reach
given: a member of another Organization
when: they read the Property's standing and overdue
then: they see nothing
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-30: a member of another Organization reads no standing

situation: An instalment is accommodation revenue
given: a charged instalment and its reversal
then: it credits Accommodation Revenue, 4000, and the reversal debits it, as a room night does, and not Other Revenue
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-31: the worker posts every instalment line of the Folio to the ledger

situation: The operating model is not read
given: a plan's functions and triggers
when: the database is swept for operating_model
then: none mentions it: a dormitory and a hotel have one set of rules (ADR 0057)
test_name: payment_plans.test.sql: PP-S1-32: none of the plan's functions or triggers reads the operating model

situation: The worker reports its outcome
given: a worker pass that charged, waited or failed at a Property
then: the pass logs how many instalments it charged and how many wait, and a Property whose pass failed is logged by id and the other Properties are still charged
test_name: payment-plans-worker.test.ts: a failure at one Property does not stop the next

situation: The booking dialog offers a plan for a Resident
given: a Resident booking in the dialog, at a Property whose billing is available
when: the desk picks a bed and the term
then: a Payment plan section shows a total of the price-list price times the nights, split monthly from the start date, the remainder on the first, every row editable
test_name: payment-plan-split.test.ts: a term is split monthly with the remainder on the first; new-reservation.test.tsx: splits the term monthly from the price list, every row editable (PP-S2-01); payment-plans.spec.ts: registering a student for a term makes the plan the dialog showed, in three languages

situation: Open at a dormitory, one press away at a hotel
given: a Property whose operating model is dormitory, and one whose model is hotel
when: the dialog opens for a Resident
then: the section is open at the first and closed with one press to open at the second; the model chooses this default and nothing else
test_name: new-reservation.test.tsx: opens by itself at a dormitory and with one press at a hotel (PP-S2-02); payment-plans.spec.ts: a hotel opens the plan with one press, and a Property that keeps no Folios offers none

situation: Every row is the desk's to change
given: a prefilled schedule
when: the desk edits an amount or date, adds a row or removes one
then: the rows change, the total and its difference from the price-list total are shown, and a difference does not block saving
test_name: new-reservation.test.tsx: a different total is shown and does not block the booking (PP-S2-03)

situation: The term end is required with a plan
given: a Resident booking with the plan section on and no departure date
then: the dialog says the plan needs a departure date and does not submit
test_name: new-reservation.test.tsx: a plan asks for a departure date (PP-S2-04)

situation: The booking and its plan are one act
given: a plan the database refuses
then: the booking is not made, the dialog keeps what was typed, and the refusal is said in the desk's words
test_name: payment-plans.test.ts: a plan the database refuses leaves no booking behind; new-reservation.test.tsx: says what to change when the plan is refused (PP-S2-05)

situation: A Guest booking has no plan
given: a booking whose type is Guest
then: there is no plan section and no plan is sent
test_name: new-reservation.test.tsx: a Guest's booking has no plan, however it was begun (PP-S2-06)

situation: A bed with no price starts empty
given: a bed the price list does not price
when: the desk turns the plan on
then: the total is empty for the desk to type and no schedule is invented from a price that is not there
test_name: payment-plan-split.test.ts: no price, no schedule (PP-S2-07); new-reservation.test.tsx: an unpriced bed starts with an empty total and no invented schedule (PP-S2-07)

situation: A Property that keeps no Folios offers no plan
given: a Property whose billing is unavailable
when: the dialog is open for a Resident
then: the section is absent, because a plan nothing could charge is refused with RZP06
test_name: new-reservation.test.tsx: a Property that keeps no Folios offers none (PP-S2-08); payment-plans.test.ts: a Property that keeps no Folios, one with no front desk, and one nobody can reach, offer none; reservations-page.test.tsx: PP-S2-08: hands the booking form the plan the Property offers, or none

situation: Turkish, English and Arabic
given: the dialog in each language
then: every word is in the catalogue, the Arabic mirrors, and the dormitory words come through the words overlay
test_name: messages-icu.test.ts: every catalogue parses; payment-plans.spec.ts: registering a student for a term makes the plan the dialog showed, in three languages

situation: The schedule on a booking
given: a Resident booking with a plan
then: each instalment shows its number, due date, amount and where it stands, with the paid and outstanding totals as large soft numerals
test_name: payment-plan-section.test.tsx: reads many: what is paid and still to pay as the large figures, then each instalment with where it stands; payment-plan-section.test.tsx: names every standing in every locale; payment-plans.spec.ts: a Resident's booking shows its schedule, takes a plan later, and the Folio names an instalment in the reader's language

situation: Add a plan to a booking that has none
given: a Resident booking with a departure date and no plan
when: the desk chooses to add one
then: the same section opens prefilled from the price list, and saving makes the plan
test_name: payment-plan-section.test.tsx: opens prefilled from the price list for what is left of the term, with no way to choose none; payment-plan-section.test.tsx: sends what the dialog showed and shows the schedule it made; payment-plan-section.test.tsx: keeps the dialog open and says what to change when the plan is refused; payment-plan-section.test.tsx: asks for a departure date instead of offering a plan to an open-ended booking; payment-plans.spec.ts: a Resident's booking shows its schedule, takes a plan later, and the Folio names an instalment in the reader's language

situation: Revise from the booking
given: a plan with charged and uncharged instalments and a Finance member
when: they edit the uncharged ones and give a reason
then: deferred: revising from the booking is not built in this stage; the module and the database already revise (PP-S1), and Finance reaches that through the module until a screen is designed with the owner. charged ones are shown as fixed, the rest are replaced as the next revision, and the reason is in the audit record

situation: Only finance sees the revise affordance
given: a Front desk member on a booking with a plan
then: deferred: there is no revise affordance to offer or withhold until PP-S3-03 is built; the schedule itself offers none, so no role is shown a revise it would be refused. they read the schedule and are not offered a revise they would be refused

situation: An instalment reads as one on the Folio
given: a charged instalment on the Folio
then: the line reads the instalment's number of the total in the reader's language, not the stored English
test_name: folio-panel.test.tsx: an_instalment_reads_as_its_place_in_the_plan_and_so_does_its_reversal; folio-panel.test.tsx: an_instalment_is_named_by_its_numbers_never_by_the_description_the_database_wrote; folio-panel.test.tsx: an_instalment_reads_in_every_locale; payment-plans.test.ts: the Folio names a charged instalment by its place in the plan, and a line somebody typed to look like one stays what they typed (PP-S3-05); payment-plans.spec.ts: a Resident's booking shows its schedule, takes a plan later, and the Folio names an instalment in the reader's language

situation: Empty, one and many
given: a booking with no plan, with one instalment, with many
then: an empty state offering the plan, a singular noun for one instalment, a plural for many
test_name: payment-plan-section.test.tsx: reads one, in the singular; payment-plan-section.test.tsx: reads many: what is paid and still to pay as the large figures, then each instalment with where it stands; payment-plan-section.test.tsx: offers to add one where the desk is looking

situation: The overdue read is for the Today screen
given: the Today lane
when: it needs students overdue and their rows
then: the module exposes the Property's overdue figure and the rows behind it, named for what they count
test_name: payment-plans.test.ts: counts Residents, instalments and money overdue, and opens the rows it counts; payment-plans.test.ts: is zero, and still names the currency, where nobody is overdue

situation: A payment allocated to a chosen instalment
given: a Folio with charges other than instalments, or a payment meant for one instalment
then: deferred: the oldest instalment is settled first, the general case; a payment toward a damage charge is laid over instalments all the same, which this row would end

situation: A plan made by mistake is removed
given: a plan with nothing charged
then: deferred: a plan is revised to what is owed and a booking that should have none is registered without one; a plan is never deleted

situation: A changed term end offers to revise the plan
given: a booking with a plan whose departure date moves
then: deferred: an instalment due after a shortened term is withdrawn at check-out; offering the revision at the amendment is its own design

situation: Late fees and interest
given: an overdue instalment
then: deferred: Turkish yurts differ, and a penalty is a pricing rule blueprint 15.10 leaves to its own approval

situation: A reminder when an instalment falls overdue
given: an overdue instalment
when: the day after its due date
then: deferred: messages to the Resident or the veli are RANZ-112 and wait for the delivery foundation (RANZ-85)

situation: An invoice per instalment
given: a charged instalment
then: deferred: the e-Arşiv invoice is RANZ-113

situation: Senet documents
given: a yurt that takes promissory notes
when: a senet is received, banked or returned
then: deferred: this plan schedules amounts and dates, the general case; a note's number, holder and custody are a specialisation to design with a partner yurt

situation: A discount or a scholarship on the plan
given: a student with a reduced fee
then: deferred: the desk types the amounts it wants; a rule that derives them is a pricing rule

situation: A plan for a whole block of students at once
given: a registration week
then: deferred: bulk move-in is RANZ-98; each registration makes its own plan

situation: A plan for a Guest
given: a long short-stay Guest who wants to pay in parts
then: deferred: a plan is a Resident's, because a Guest is charged by the night and a plan beside it would charge twice (RT-S3-05)
